messages:
Maria Chen: HelionCore X2 EAP confirmed — NDA signed by both sides. 6-week preview window starting Mon 2026-04-05. Need to lock bench plan, telemetry tokens, and sample prompt set. Partner POC: Evan (Helion). Can someone own scheduling + bench harness? :party:
Jake Patel: I'll take bench harness. Quick Q: what are Helion's perf targets? p95/p99 or tail-latency focus? Also need concurrency and token-length targets.
Evan (Helion): Thanks Maria. We'll provide 4 nodes (2x A100-like configs). For targets: aiming for p95 <= 180ms on 2048-token gen, p99 under 300ms is ideal. We'll share ssh + ssh-key and a telemetry token (read-only).
Sofia Ramos: Legal — small redline on telemetry retention. What's our default retention and S3 export policy? Also confirm that customer data won't be used for training (they requested explicit clause).
legal-bot: NDA link: https://contracts.redwood/helion/nda-v2.pdf. Standard telemetry retention = 90 days, S3 exports available on request. Clause added re: no-training w/o opt-in.
Lukas Meyer: Nice. I'll add a runbook snippet to the repo and wire telemetry. Bench command we'll use:
```
./bench/run.sh --model helion_x2 --seq 2048 --concurrency 8 --duration 600
```
Metrics to collect: p95,p99,tail-latency samples, token throughput, KV cache hit rate, gpu_util, cpu_steal, gpu_temp, telemetry token usage. Suggest kickoff sync Thu 10am PT. Who's in?
Maria Chen: Thu 10am PT works for product + partner. @Sofia please confirm legal can join for the 15m sign-off. Evan, can you confirm the node readiness and keys by Wed EOD?
Evan (Helion): Confirmed — keys + initial telemetry token by Wed EOD. We'll also attach a small prompt set (50 prompts) and expected outputs to check functional parity.
Jake Patel: I'll prep harness + perf dashboard. Will post PR with runbook + dashboards by Wed.
Sofia Ramos: I can join Thu short sign-off. Noted the no-training clause.
Maria Chen: Great — marking action items:
- Evan: provide keys + telemetry token + prompt set by Wed EOD
- Jake: bench harness + PR by Wed
- Lukas: runbook + metrics wiring
- Sofia: legal sign-off Thu
Thanks all! :thumbsup:
